title: UN Warns Drone Attacks Are Killing Civilians and Crippling Sudan's Power Infrastructure
detail: Drone attacks across Sudan killed at least 14 civilians (Dabanga via allAfrica, Nov 4): 8 at Um Dibo, West Kordofan; at least 4 at a fuel station in El Abbasiya Tagali, South Kordofan; 2 in Ed Damazin, Blue Nile. Strikes on power infrastructure (Kassala, Merowe, River Nile, Red Sea, North Kordofan, Gezira, Khartoum, Sennar, Gedaref) caused widespread outages and disrupted water supply, raising waterborne disease risk. The Arab League, attributing the attacks to the RSF, said targeting civilian infrastructure may amount to a war crime and named Zaid Al-Sabban envoy for Sudan; UN Secretary-General condemned escalating drone attacks and urged a cessation of hostilities.

media.caption: UN warns drone attacks killing civilians, crippling power infrastructure
